sentences.text:
4. The brief facts of the case are to the effect that a sale deed was executed on 03.11.2011 by the petitioner-Ram Babu in favour of Smt. Veena Misra, which was registered on 04.10.2011 and thereafter with regard to the same property another sale deed was executed in favour of Smt. Ashok Kumari, which was registered on 13.10.2011.
5.

Aggrieved by the aforesaid, an FIR against the petitioner and others was lodged by Smt. Veena Misra, which was registered as Case Crime No. 1012 of 2011 under Section 419/420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Gonda.

6. Thereafter another FIR was lodged by Smt. Ashok Kumari in whose favour second deed was executed by the petitioner, which was registered as Case Crime No. 1060 of 2011 under Section 419/420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Gonda.
7. After the aforesaid, the petitioner filed complaint case impleading private opposite party no.(s) 2 to 6 namely Raju Misra, Sri Dhar, Smt. Veena Misra, Rajesh Kumar and Maheswari.

This complaint case was registered as Case No. 2111/2011 (Ram Babu Versus Rajeev Mishra and others) and Magistrate taking note of the statement recorded before it in terms of Section 200 and 202 Cr.P.C.
vide its order dated 28.01.2013, summoned Raju Misra s/o Shridhar, Shridhar s/o Chote Lal, Smt.
Veena Misra w/o Raju Misra, Rajesh Kumar s/o Mishri Lal and Maheswari s/o Ganpat.
8.

9. It would be apt to indicate that the petitioner has also filed a suit for cancellation of sale deed favourable to Smt. Veena Misra, as appears from record.

10. In the aforesaid background of the case, the present petition has been filed.
11. Upon due consideration of the arguments advanced by learned Counsel for the petitioner and  learned A.G.A., this Court finds no force in the present petition.

It is for the reason that the complaint case filed by the petitioner, is nothing but an abuse of process of law as after two FIRs lodged by the purchasers against the petitioner, to save his skin, filed a complaint case and before this Court there is no evidence to establish that subsequent sale deed was not signed by the petitioner.
12.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed.

13. Cost made easy.
